title: How is exit-strip temperature controlled on a continuous strip annealing line?
summary: A Suneng technical agreement for an 1850 mm coil annealing line separately provides air cooling, air/water mist, water spraying and drying, with strip-temperature measurement at the heating, air-cooling and drying exits. Selection should assess how these measurements relate to airflow, water flow and main-line operation. Total cooling length alone does not establish exit temperature.
